question.text: In the context of SME issues, what is the minimum underwriting requirement?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.232, an SME initial public offer must be 100% underwritten and is not restricted to the minimum subscription level. The lead manager(s) must underwrite at least 15% of the issue size on their own account. The Trap: 50%, 75% and 90% do not match the 100% SME underwriting rule prescribed in the source. Note: Beyond the 100% offer-level underwriting, the lead manager's separate 15% minimum on-own-account underwriting obligation is also a source-backed rule.
